aggregation_rules: Do not sum nested timing intervals as disjoint costs.
Retain cold initialization, actual cache hits, failures, rejected requests, and all emitted files.
Report image/video paired costs separately from audio/text functional coverage.
Keep aggregate hardware/runtime counts separate from assumed utility-price conversion.
No output observation is reused as target truth evidence.
No source WAV is decoded for the late evidence event before the native acquire decision commits.

frozen_wall_cost_sensitivity.scope: Original frozen descriptive sensitivity only; no post-outcome rate selection or replacement primary.

per_request_existing_fields.input_video_receipt: Actual source-video encode/decode preparation where recorded.
per_request_existing_fields.native_execution_us: Retain every original per-candidate timing, including refusals.
per_request_existing_fields.observed_ns_minus_generation_started_ns: Actual combined generation/acquisition and public observation interval; do not invent a separate unrecorded decoder/codec split.
per_request_existing_fields.owner_execution_us: Sum of measured original owner tick times.
per_request_existing_fields.owner_peak_bytes: Recorded owner accounting peak; not whole Python RSS.
per_request_existing_fields.planning_us: Sum of recorded native decision planning calls.
per_request_existing_fields.registered_cost: 0.002 times acquire_attempts plus emit_attempts; fixed utility penalty, not measured currency.
per_request_existing_fields.source_CNN_wall_ns: Actual late source loading/spectrum/CNN work after the acquire commit; source_acquisition_cached stays false.
per_request_existing_fields.speech.events.historical_asr_wall_ns: Historical cache provenance only, not this-run CPU or wall spend.
per_request_existing_fields.speech.request_wall_ns: Actual this-run cached or cold observation request latency.
per_request_existing_fields.whole_execution_wall_ns: Input preparation through completed attempt, including failures and closure. Offline score-writing and final study analysis are outside this timer.

separate_noninference_ledgers.HWD_public_metadata_review: Separate feasibility access receipts, no model execution.
separate_noninference_ledgers.native_builds: Existing build-001..005 receipts, including the failed first build.
separate_noninference_ledgers.old_development_and_calibration: Retain existing calibration attempts and old-source evidence; do not charge them as a fresh inference timing.
separate_noninference_ledgers.root_verified_reclaim_002: Root-owned shared maintenance receipt; not native inference cost. Parent reports 35.096 s maintenance, kept outside efficacy timing.

whole_process.cgroup_scope: Aggregate shared environment counters, with explicit before/after OOM and OOM-kill counts; not attributable standalone model memory.
whole_process.measurement: Outer stdlib supervisor around the exact command. Use perf_counter_ns for wall duration, time_ns for UTC receipt times, and Linux RUSAGE_CHILDREN before/after for CPU totals. No model imports in the supervisor.
whole_process.peak_RSS_scope: Linux waited-child ru_maxrss is the largest reported process peak, converted from KiB to bytes; it is not a measured simultaneous process-tree peak. Evaluator self peak remains separately reported.
whole_process.wall_scope: Includes child interpreter startup, closure verification, cold model initialization, input preparation, all owner/media episodes, scoring, fixed analysis, final closure verification, and report writing.
